root_cause.text: The `adf_probe()` function in the `qat_6xxx` driver fails to call `adf_dev_down()` to detach registered IRQ handlers when `adf_dev_up()` partially completes and fails, causing devres to release MSI-X vectors while IRQ handlers are still attached.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that in `adf_probe()`, when `adf_dev_up(accel_dev, true)` returns an error, `adf_dev_down(accel_dev)` is now explicitly called to clean up the IRQ handlers before returning the error.

bic_trace_step.reason: In the adf_probe() function, adf_dev_up() is called at line 201. If it fails, the function immediately returns the error code at line 203. However, the devres action to call adf_device_down() (which invokes adf_dev_down()) is only registered at line 205, after adf_dev_up() has already succeeded. If adf_dev_up() partially completes and then fails, adf_dev_down() is never called to detach the registered IRQ handlers, causing devres to release MSI-X vectors while IRQ handlers are still attached.
